newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian peso ends slightly off at 1,101.65.
newsitem.headline: Colombian peso ends slightly off at 1,101.65.

text.p: Colombia's peso ended slightly lower at 1,101.65 in quiet trading on the country's interbank market, dealers said.
They said the 0.65 centavo slip from Thursday's close was caused by subdued dollar buying in an otherwise actionless session because of the July 4th holiday in the United States.
Dealers reported just 100 trades for a total of $59 million and said the peso held in a narrow 1,101.00-to-1,102.75 range.
